notes.title: Blockhead is now available!
notes.content:
Hello Blockheads-in-waiting,

The time is upon us, and Blockhead is now available to download! You can pick it up completely free, so head on over to the store page to give it a go!

Blockhead is a puzzle platformer that focuses on the strengths of both genres. Puzzles consist of a few simple rules that can be combined into complex brainteasers. This is paired with tough platforming, which ensures that finding the solution is only part of the challenge. If you loved puzzle platformers of the early 90s, we think you'll enjoy Blockhead too!

For more info, be sure to check out the Blockhead page on our blog [url=https://loonycode.wordpress.com/blockhead/]here[/url]. We hope you enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948170/
